en: Mayon Volcano in Albay is famous for its nearly perfect cone shape.
The Cagayan River is the longest river in the Philippines, flowing through the Cagayan Valley.
Laguna de Bay in Luzon is the largest lake in the Philippines and a vital source of fish.
Mount Apo in Davao is the highest mountain in the Philippines, standing at 2,954 meters above sea level.
The Philippine eagle, found in Mindanao, is one of the largest and most powerful eagles in the world.
Luzon is the largest and most populous island in the Philippines, containing the capital city of Manila.
The Philippine Sea, located east of the archipelago, is home to the deep Philippine Trench.
The amihan, or northeast monsoon, brings cool and dry weather to the Philippines between November and February.
The Philippines is a top global producer of abaca, a strong plant fiber used to make ropes and textiles.
Tubbataha Reefs Natural Park in the Sulu Sea is a protected marine sanctuary famous for its coral biodiversity.
The Banaue Rice Terraces in Ifugao are ancient agricultural landscapes carved into the mountains over two thousand years ago.
Palawan is a long island province known for its underground river in Puerto Princesa and rich wildlife.
